card.name: The digit 3 in numbers and dates
card.fires_on: The digit 3, or a unit word right after a 3, inside numbers, years, dates and durations such as 1933, 2013, 16 Mar, or 3 weeks. It also fires weakly on list markers like c.

modes.label: Digit 3 in numbers
modes.description: The digit 3 as part of a longer number, year or ID.
modes.example: 193<<3>>, only the Nazi party was legal.

modes.label: Unit after 3
modes.description: A time or measure word right after a 3 in a duration.

modes.label: Date month
modes.description: A month name in a date that follows a number.

card.writes: It suppresses ordinal-style endings like rd and quarters, which fit after a 3 (3rd), and promotes name or word continuations.
card.plain: It lights up on the digit 3, or on a word right after a 3, in years, dates and durations.
